_README: Adjudicated real-bug benchmark: pre-fix/post-fix ASL pairs mined from public Step Functions repos (eval/mine_realbugs.js). A catch counts only when StepCheck flags a defect on the pre-fix version that the fix genuinely resolves (not a count drop from deleting the flagged state). Run: stepcheck eval-pairs corpus/realbugs --infer.

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: Reads '$.Execution.Input' (single '$' selects a document field 'Execution' no state produces; the execution input is the context object '$$.Execution.Input'). The '.$' read fails at run time.
Two tasks read '$.profile.Item' and '$.userId', fields not produced at those states.
confirmed_real_bugs.fix: Refactors the user-data flow onto produced fields ($.user, $.user.pk.S).

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: A Choice guards on '$.profile.subscription.level', a field never produced -> the subscriber branch is unreachable (dead guard); subscribers were never routed.
confirmed_real_bugs.fix: Corrects the guard to the produced path '$.user.subscription.M.level.S'.

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: A callback task 'Router' has neither TimeoutSeconds nor HeartbeatSeconds and can wait indefinitely.
A transition targets an undefined state 'GoWithSupplier' (invalid ASL).
A state declares 'End': 'True' (a STRING, not the boolean true), so it is not recognised as terminal -> dead-end (SC0004), unreachable states (SC0003), and no reachable terminal (SC0005).
confirmed_real_bugs.fix: Sets 'End': true and rewires the missing transitions.

rejected.reason: SC4001 count dropped only because the fix DELETED a persistent task, not because compensation was added (the post version even introduces a new SC0002). A count decrease, not a resolved defect -> not credited.
